def utc_timestamp(text):
    """Return the integer Unix seconds for ``text`` as UTC.

    ``text`` is an ISO 8601 datetime string with a required explicit timezone
    and may use ``Z`` for the UTC zone. The returned value is the number of
    seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC.

    A naive datetime (no timezone information) is rejected with a ``ValueError``.
    """
    from datetime import datetime
    from decimal import Decimal

    if "Z" in text:
        value = datetime.fromisoformat(text).astimezone().timestamp()
    else:
        value = datetime.fromisoformat(text).timestamp()

    return int(value)
